name: Roses de Chloé
description: Damask rose leads, brightened by bergamot and lychee and softened with peach and magnolia. Cedar and white musk give the finish a gentle, woody hush.

name: Arso
description: A dark, resinous woody scent: cedar wood and leather lead into frankincense and pine resin.

name: Davidoff Adventure
description: Bergamot, lemon and mandarin meet tea, pepper and maté, then sesame and spice. Cedarwood, musk and vetiver provide an earthy base.

name: Bamboo
description: Orange blossom and bergamot lift a creamy heart of ylang-ylang, lily and jasmine. Sandalwood and vanilla leave a sweet, soft finish.

description: Citrus and herbs on a mossy woody base: blood orange and black pepper, then lavender, wormwood and orange blossom, with tonka and cedarwood beneath.

description: Musk threads through every stage, with orange blossom at the heart and vanilla at the base. A soft, clean, skin-close sweetness.

name: Attimo
description: Pear and lotus open onto a creamy trio of frangipani, gardenia and peony, with patchouli, musk and Virginia cedar to close.

name: Anaïs Anaïs
description: Hyacinth and honeysuckle give way to a creamy bouquet of jasmine, lily of the valley and rose, settling into mossy oakmoss, vetiver and a hint of blackcurrant.

name: Hugo Woman
description: Blackberry, cut grass and Italian mandarin lead into black tea, jasmine, plum and iris, drying to amber, cedar and sandalwood.

name: Psychédélique
description: A patchouli-led scent with citrus on top, cistus, amber, geranium and rose in the middle, and vanilla and musk in the base.

description: A short, sweet pyramid: rose on top, almond and honey in the middle, vanilla beneath. Simple and gourmand, with a honeyed, nutty softness around the floral note.

name: Ta'if
description: A spiced rose: pink pepper, saffron and dates open to rose, freesia and orange flower, finishing on vanilla, broom and amber.

name: Lady Vengeance
description: An aromatic floral with bergamot and lavender up front, rose and patchouli in the middle, and a clean, skin-like ambroxan base.

name: Sicily
description: Bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin and pineapple make a bright fruit salad of citrus, followed by ylang-ylang, violet, rose and jasmine. Musk and woody notes end it softly.

name: Signature
description: Clementine's bright juice gives way to vanilla, then a soft white musk. Simple, sweet and gently warm.

description: Blackcurrant opens tart and fruity, then a boozy heart of rum. Vanilla rounds everything into a warm, sweet finish.

name: Poême
description: Lychee and poppy open lightly fruity. Orange blossom, mimosa and jasmine follow, ending in a powdery, creamy vanilla base.

description: A short, soft leather scent: ambrette seed and saffron on top, suede and ginger in the heart, finished with musk and leather. Warm, smooth and lightly spicy.

name: Angel Elixir
description: Creamy golden florals sit in warm amber and bourbon vanilla. Rich and enveloping.

name: Narciso Poudrée

name: Bad Boy Cobalt
description: Pink pepper and lavender lead to geranium and plum. Mushroom, vetiver and cedarwood make a distinctly earthy, herbal base.

description: Orange opens softly over a powdery heart of iris, daffodil and magnolia. Vanilla, ambergris and sandalwood finish it warm and gently creamy.

name: Bellodgia

description: Calypsone, pink pepper and bergamot open airy, then lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk end soft, sweet and creamy.

name: Eilish

name: Escentric 03

description: Petitgrain gives a bitter-green start, ginger adds spice, and rosewood leaves a woody base.

name: Victory Man
description: Orange opens bright, lavender gives an herbal centre, and patchouli ends the line earthy. Fresh, citrusy and dry.

name: Voyage Bleu Man
description: Bergamot and mint make a cool, citrusy opening, and cedarwood gives a dry, woody close. Clean and fresh.

name: Voyage Brown Man
description: Grapefruit opens crisp, violet leaf gives a green heart, and woody notes close dry.

name: Voyage Titan pour Homme
description: Bergamot brightens a geranium heart, and sandalwood finishes it with a smooth, woody warmth.

name: Yum Yum
description: Cherry, wild berries, bergamot and orange start bright and juicy, vanilla, white flowers and rose make a soft heart, and powdery notes, amber and musk close sweet.

name: Acqua di Giò Eau de Toilette
description: A marine freshness of sea notes and citrus, with jasmine, rosemary and freesia in the heart. Musk, cedarwood, oakmoss and amber finish clean and soft.

name: Acqua di Giò Elixir
description: An aquatic accord and violet sit under a bright bergamot and mandarin top. Patchouli and leather add a faint, dark, salty depth beneath the freshness.

name: Acqua di Gio Parfum
description: Sea notes and bergamot open crisp, lavender and rosemary add a herbal heart, and frankincense with patchouli leave a dry, earthy base.

name: Acqua Di Giò Profondo
description: Sea notes and cypress give a deep, salty, green freshness, resting on soft musk. Cool and clean, like wind off dark water.

name: Armani Code Absolu
description: Ginger and neroli open lightly spiced. Jasmine, orange blossom and tuberose form a creamy white floral heart, and tonka bean and vanilla leave it sweet and smooth.

name: Armani Code Eau de Toilette
description: A clean lavandin heart, brightened by mandarin. Tonka bean and cedarwood add a sweet, woody softness at the base.

name: Blanc Kogane
description: Aldehydes, lemon and pink pepper give a crisp, airy start. Jasmine and ylang-ylang soften the heart, and musk, vetiver and patchouli make the base clean and earthy.

name: Emporio Armani Because It's You
description: Raspberry, neroli and lemon open juicy and bright. Rose sits at the centre, and vanilla, musk and amberwood leave a soft, warm finish.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely
description: Rum opens boozy and warm, lavender gives a herbal heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely
description: Pink pepper and juniper open sharp, lavender, cinnamon and sage add herbal spice, and vanilla, tonka bean and chestnut make a sweet, nutty base.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Parfum
description: Mandarin and pink pepper brighten a herbal heart of lavender and sage. Chestnut and vanilla give the base a sweet, toasted softness.

name: I Will
description: Bergamot opens clean, vanilla adds a rounded sweetness, and leather gives a faintly smoky edge. Warm and quietly sweet.

name: My Way Intense
description: Orange blossom and bergamot open bright, tuberose and jasmine make a creamy white floral heart, and cedarwood, vanilla and musk end soft and smooth.

name: My Way Ylang
description: Mango, coconut, orange blossom and bergamot open sunny and tropical. Ylang-ylang and tuberose make a creamy heart, and musk, vanilla and cedarwood end soft.

name: Stronger With You Absolutely
description: Boozy rum and aromatic lavender over a base of cedarwood and vanilla. Sweet, warm and woody, with a smooth finish.

name: Stronger With You
description: Cardamom, pink pepper, violet leaf and mint open crisp. Sage, melon and pineapple add a juicy heart, and vanilla, chestnut, cedarwood and amberwood end sweet and warm.

name: Iris Fauve
description: Bergamot, cinnamon and iris open powdery and spiced, then patchouli, vetiver and cypress add green earth. Sage, labdanum and musk give the base a dry, resinous softness.

name: Lune Feline
description: Cinnamon, cardamom and pink pepper open warm and bright, with cedarwood, ambergris and styrax in a smoky heart. Vanilla, balsam of Peru and musk finish it rich and resinous.

name: Pink Me Up
description: Bergamot and orange blossom open sparkling, with champagne, rose and blackberry making a bubbly, fruity heart. Patchouli, iris and musk give the base a soft, powdery finish.

name: Riviera Lazuli
description: Lemon, cypress and bergamot open crisp, with sage, cedarwood and guaiac wood in a dry, herbal heart. Immortelle, frankincense and fir balsam leave a resinous, coastal-woods finish.

name: Riviera Sunrise
description: Lemon, mandarin and orange open sun-bright, then fig, basil and orange blossom give the heart a green, juicy softness. Vetiver, cedarwood and musk make a clean, woody base.

name: Gold Fair in Mayfair
description: Absinthe and nutmeg open herbal and spiced, with chocolate, sage and iris at the centre. Ambroxan, styrax and vetiver close it, a warm, powdery scent with a green edge.

name: Mint Tonic
description: Mint, lime and grapefruit make a cool, zesty start, with ginger and geranium adding a spiced, floral heart. Musk, vetiver and cedarwood leave a clean, dry finish.

name: Oud Save The King
description: Tea and bergamot open crisp, with suede and iris giving the heart a powdery, smoky softness. Sandalwood and oud close it, creamy and dark beneath the freshness.

name: Oud Save The Queen
description: Tea, clove and bergamot open bright, then jasmine and orange blossom make a creamy, floral heart. Oud, tonka bean and guaiac wood leave a warm, smoky base.

name: Rose in Wonderland
description: Rose and blackcurrant open fruity and bright, with geranium adding a green, floral heart. Vetiver and amber give the base an earthy, golden warmth.

name: Shine Despite Everything
description: Pimento, frankincense and turmeric open warm and spiced, then caramel, rose and iris sweeten the heart. Coumarin, vanilla and akigalawood leave a soft, glowing, woody base.

name: The Other Side of Oud
description: Ginger, cinnamon and cardamom open warm and spiced, with geranium and roasted coffee at the heart. Vanilla and oud finish it dark and sweet, the coffee echoing through the base.

name: Azzaro Pour Homme
description: An aromatic, herbal classic: lavender, sage, basil and anise over bergamot, with cardamom and sandalwood in the heart. Leather, tonka bean and oakmoss give a dry, earthy base.

name: Chrome Legend
description: Tea, mint and orange make a cool, watery opening, with oakmoss and musk running through the heart. Cedarwood and vetiver close it dry and earthy, still crisp throughout.

name: Chrome
description: Bergamot is clean and sparkling over a clear heart of musk. A green touch of maté in the base keeps the finish fresh, light and skin-close.

name: The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense
description: Cardamom adds a bright spice at the start, then caramel turns the heart sweet and glossy. Amberwood closes it warm and dry, balancing the sugar with a woody glow.

name: Wanted Eau de Parfum
description: Juniper opens crisp and gin-like, with sage adding a herbal, slightly savoury heart. Vetiver dries the finish into something earthy and green.

name: Blanc Galaxie
description: Cedrat, mandarin, lime and petitgrain make a bright, bitter citrus opening, with myrtle, magnolia and cardamom adding green, floral spice. Patchouli lends the finish an earthy depth.

name: Bleu Infini
description: Pink pepper and clary sage open sharp, while labdanum and lichen add a mossy, resinous warmth. Akigalawood and oakmoss ground it, a dry, earthy and herbal scent.

name: Bleu Infini
description: Built around labdanum, lichen and pink pepper, it pairs a gentle spice with a mossy, resinous warmth. Earthy and dry, it feels calm and slightly smoky.

name: Cuir Elysees
description: Leather and raspberry open together, dark and fruity, with pink pepper adding a bright spice. Jasmine and sandalwood soften the heart, leaving a creamy, floral-woody trail.

name: Ebene
description: Ebony wood leads, dry and dark, with myrrh, incense and tobacco adding resinous smoke. Geranium lifts the heart with a green floral touch, while cedarwood keeps the finish clean.

name: Aqua Sapphire
description: Davana, rum, saffron and pineapple open sweet and spiced, with rose, algae and musk in a salty heart. Amber, oakmoss, sandalwood, vanilla and cypriol give a deep, mossy finish.

name: Blue Sapphire
description: Lemon, orange, marigold, saffron and sage open bright and herbal, followed by cardamom, magnolia, rose and jasmine. Amber, oud, patchouli and vetiver make a rich, earthy base.

name: Bodacious
description: Cherry, clove, almond and cognac open boozy and sweet, with jasmine sambac, heliotrope and rose in the heart. Tonka bean, amber, vanilla and tobacco leave a warm, powdery trail.

name: Defender
description: Cognac, ginger, honey and liquorice open rich and sweet, with jasmine, myrrh and orange blossom in the heart. Labdanum, leather and amber give the base a deep, resinous warmth.

name: Empire
description: Peach, plum, mandarin and pink pepper open juicy, then gardenia, magnolia, rose and jasmine sambac bloom. Sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and raspberry keep the base creamy and sweet.

name: Monarch
description: Bergamot, grapefruit, tea and cypress open crisp, with rose, jasmine, cinnamon and cardamom in a spiced floral heart. Leather, oakmoss, labdanum, vanilla and oud make a layered, resinous base.

name: Brit
description: Pear and lime give a juicy start, with almond running sweet through the heart. Amber and vanilla settle underneath, warm and soft, with a faint woodiness from mahogany.

name: Goddess
description: Vanilla and lavender meet an unexpected salty note of caviar in the heart. It is sweet and creamy, with a briny edge that keeps the warmth from turning heavy.

name: Hero Eau de Parfum
description: Resinous and woody, with a cool pine needle top that gives way to the balm of benzoin. Cedarwood rounds out the base, leaving a green, warm and quietly smoky finish.

name: Hero Eau de Toilette
description: Bergamot is bright and clean over a heart of cedarwood. Pepper and juniper in the base add a dry, herbal sharpness, keeping the whole scent fresh and woody.

name: Hero Parfum
description: Cypress opens green and cool, with amyris adding a smooth, dry wood in the heart. Cedarwood closes it, a fresh, quiet woody scent with an outdoor feel.

name: London
description: Rose, mandarin and honeysuckle open lightly, with jasmine, peony and gardenia opening into a creamy floral heart. Patchouli, musk and sandalwood give it a soft, warm finish.

name: My Burberry
description: Sweet pea and a squeeze of citrus open bright, then geranium, freesia and juicy peach flow into the heart. Patchouli, rose, violet and musk leave a soft, fresh floral trail.

name: My Burberry Blush
description: Lemon and pomegranate sparkle on top, with rose, apple and geranium forming a juicy, rosy heart. Jasmine and wisteria close it soft, a light floral that stays fresh and fruity.

name: Allegra Baciami
description: Gardenia opens creamy, vanilla warms the heart, and amber closes sweet and soft.

name: Allegra Chill & Sole
description: Lemon brightens the opening, then neroli gives a soft, creamy white-floral heart. Petitgrain keeps the finish green and clean, a light, sunlit citrus with a gentle bloom running through it.

name: Eau Parfumee the Imperial
description: Crisp citrus and a calm, green tea accord sit over a quiet bed of musk. It reads fresh and airy, cool rather than sweet, and stays soft all the way down.

name: Le Gemme Gyan
description: Orange opens bright before jasmine sambac turns the heart creamy and floral. Patchouli grounds it with an earthy, slightly dark base, so the sunny start settles into something rounder.

name: Le Gemme Kobraa
description: Geranium opens green and floral, then incense drifts in with a smoky, resinous warmth. Oud closes it richly, giving a dense, glowing base beneath the petals.

name: Le Gemme Tygar
description: Grapefruit gives a sharp, sparkling start, and ginger adds a warm, spicy lift. Ambroxan finishes in a smooth amber glow, so the citrus fades into something warm and mineral.

name: Man In Black
description: A dark spice opening gives way to tuberose, creamy and slightly narcotic. Benzoin lends a resinous, balsamic warmth underneath, making a floral that feels deep and smouldering.

name: Alto Astral
description: Aldehydes and coconut open with a creamy shimmer, followed by incense, jasmine and musk. Sandalwood, cashmere wood and amber leave it warm and smooth.

name: Animalique
description: A heart of suede, violet and mimosa sits under bright bergamot and lemon. Amber, sandalwood and tobacco give it a warm, smoky, powdery depth.

name: De Los Santos
description: Clary sage and plum begin dry and slightly fruity, followed by powdery iris and resinous labdanum. Musk, ambroxan and palo santo leave it smooth and warm.

name: Havana Tonka
description: Bergamot, rum, pink pepper and creme brulee open sweet and boozy. Tobacco, violet and suede add smoky depth before musk, tonka bean, patchouli and benzoin warm the base.

name: Mojave Ghost Absolu de Parfum
description: Naseberry, ambrette and pear give a soft, fruity start. Magnolia, sandalwood and violet bloom in the heart, and cedarwood, musk, amber and vetiver finish woody and smooth.

name: Mumbai Noise
description: Davana brings a fruity, herbal sweetness, tonka bean adds a creamy warmth, and oud lingers beneath. Resinous, sweet and slightly green.

name: CK One
description: A bright burst of pineapple, mandarin and bergamot opens it, with violet, iris and jasmine in a light floral heart. Sandalwood, musk and oakmoss leave a clean, airy, slightly powdery finish.

name: Defy
description: Bergamot opens bright over a heart of vetiver, earthy and dry. Amber warms the base, so the citrus slowly gives way to a grounded, gently golden finish.

name: Escape
description: Hyacinth, apple, mandarin and blackcurrant make a juicy, green opening, followed by peach, jasmine and rose. Musk, sandalwood and vanilla close it warm, with a mossy undertone.

name: Eternity for Men
description: Lavender, mandarin and lemon open clean, then basil, sage and jasmine give an herbal, floral heart. Sandalwood, vetiver and amber leave a calm, woody base.

name: Eternity
description: A soft bouquet of lily of the valley, jasmine, rose and violet with a powdery sheen. Freesia and mandarin brighten the start, while amber and sandalwood keep the finish gentle.

name: My Euphoria
description: Blackcurrant and guava open juicy and sweet, then orchid and tuberose add a creamy floral heart. Vanilla and soft woody notes make a warm, rounded base with a hint of sesame.

name: 212 VIP Men
description: Caviar, lime and mint open cool and salty, vodka and ginger add a spiced heart, and amber, musk and kingwood leave a warm, smooth finish.

name: 212 VIP Rosé
description: Champagne and pink pepper open bubbly and light. Peach blossom and rose follow with a fruity floral heart, and woody notes with musk finish softly.

name: Bad Boy Extreme
description: Ginger opens with a spiced sparkle, patchouli adds earthy depth, and chocolate leaves a dark, sweet base. Warm and dense.

name: Good Girl
description: Jasmine sambac and tuberose make a rich floral heart, almond adds a nutty sweetness, and tonka bean, chocolate and coffee leave a dark, warm base.

name: Very Good Girl Elixir
description: Cherry and almond open sweet and rich, tuberose and rose make a creamy floral heart, and vanilla with chocolate gives a warm, dessert-like finish.

name: Must de Cartier
description: A big floral chypre with a powdery shimmer: aldehydes and mandarin open it, rose, iris and jasmine fill the heart, and amber, vanilla and sandalwood close it creamy and warm.

name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
description: Peony, freesia and lychee open light and juicy, magnolia, lily of the valley and rose form the heart, and cedarwood, amber and honey close warm and sweet.

name: Chloé Rose Tangerine
description: Mandarin and blackcurrant open juicy, rose forms the floral heart, and cedarwood and amber leave a warm, woody close.

name: Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense
description: Jasmine opens creamy, dates sweeten the heart, and patchouli leaves an earthy, dark base.

name: 1872 for Women
description: A bright mix of lemon, pineapple, mandarin and blueberry opens it, followed by rose, freesia, orchid and jasmine. Sandalwood, patchouli, musk and oakmoss close it soft and woody.

name: 1872 Masculine
description: Rosemary, pepper, nutmeg and citrus open aromatic and spicy, with freesia, clary sage and jasmine in the heart. Cedarwood, sandalwood, patchouli and resins give a dry, warm base.

name: 20 Iconic Masculine
description: Built on petitgrain, mandarin and yuzu, bright and slightly bitter, with pink pepper and rosemary adding a herbal spice. Cedarwood gives the finish a clean, dry backbone.

name: Blonde Amber
description: Bergamot, bitter orange, rum and ginger open warm and boozy, then iris, jasmine, tuberose and saffron deepen the heart. Labdanum, vanilla, tonka bean and myrrh make a golden, resinous base.

name: C Woody Leather
description: Mandarin opens briefly before tobacco and saffron bring a warm, smoky spice. Leather and oud close it, dark and dry, with a woody depth that lingers quietly.

name: Crab Apple Blossom
description: Apple blossom opens crisp and green, and rhubarb and mint keep the heart cool and tart. A touch of sugar softens it, while sandalwood gives the base a creamy, quiet finish.

name: Jump Up and Kiss Me Hedonistic
description: Bergamot, grapefruit and neroli open sparkling, with cherry, maté and clary sage in a green, juicy heart. Amber, leather, labdanum and vanilla warm the base, soft and resinous.

name: No 1 Clive Christian for Men
description: Nutmeg and thyme open aromatic over a bright heart of bergamot, lime, grapefruit and cardamom. Sandalwood, tonka bean, amber and vanilla make a warm, smooth base beneath the citrus.

name: X for Women
description: Bergamot, rhubarb, peach and mandarin open juicy, then rose, jasmine, iris and tuberose bloom into a full bouquet. Vanilla, rum, patchouli and sandalwood leave a sweet, warm finish.

name: Absolu Aventus
description: Crisp ginger, grapefruit and bergamot lead, then cardamom, cinnamon and pineapple add spice and juice. Labdanum, vetiver and patchouli ground it in earthy warmth.

name: Acqua Fiorentina
description: Plum and apple open juicy and fruity, with rose and carnation blooming at the heart. Bergamot, lemon, cedarwood and sandalwood keep it clear and fresh.

name: Centaurus
description: Cardamom, cinnamon and tobacco open spicy, geranium and heliotrope bring a floral sweetness, and benzoin, tonka bean and vanilla fill the base with warm, balsamic richness.

name: Delphinus
description: Incense, almond and pink pepper open warm and spicy, with heliotrope and iris giving a powdery heart. Patchouli, tonka bean, leather and vanilla finish deep and sweet.

name: Eladaria
description: Sparkling mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper lead to rose and peony with a powdery softness. Musk, vanilla and cashmere wood leave it smooth and gentle.

name: Fleurissimo
description: Clear, green violet leaf and bergamot open the way. Rose, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom creamily at the heart, with iris and ambergris giving a soft, polished base.

name: Jardin d'Amalfi
description: A sunny, clean opening of bergamot and lemon. Vetiver, sandalwood and pepper build a dry woody heart, and ambergris adds a soft salty glow.

name: Love In Black
description: Jasmine, violet and cedarwood open soft and powdery, iris and clove add a hint of spice, and blackcurrant, rose and musk leave a dark, smooth finish.

name: Love in White for Summer
description: Rose, bergamot and magnolia open airy. Iris, basmati rice and cedarwood create a powdery, woody heart, and ambergris with sandalwood end it warm and softly sweet.

name: Neroli Sauvage
description: A bright citrus burst of bergamot, bitter orange, grapefruit and lemon, with neroli and verbena. Orange blossom and ambergris leave a soft, creamy finish.

name: Original Santal
description: Coriander, juniper and cinnamon meet creamy sandalwood, with lavender, petitgrain and rosemary adding a herbal freshness. Vanilla and tonka bean warm the base.

name: Pure White Cologne
description: Bergamot, lemon and grapefruit make a crisp opening, galbanum and pear add a green juiciness, and ambergris with musk leaves it clean and quiet.

name: Queen of Silk
description: Osmanthus, magnolia and saffron open golden. Tuberose, passion fruit and a trace of oud add fruit and depth, while vanilla, incense and myrrh give a resinous finish.

name: Royal Princess Oud
description: Rose and bergamot open bright, jasmine and vanilla fill the heart, and benzoin with sandalwood leave a sweet, resinous warmth.

name: Spring Flower
description: Bergamot, grapefruit and lemon begin fresh and zesty. Apricot, peach and jasmine add a fruity softness, and ambergris, cedarwood and musk keep it clean.

name: Sublime Vanille
description: Vanilla opens in a sweet, creamy way, and then tonka bean, lemon and bergamot lift it into sunlight. A gentle musk rounds off the end.

name: Tabarome Millésime
description: Ginger, pink pepper and grapefruit give a spiced citrus start. Tea, coffee, rum and blackcurrant fill the heart, and sandalwood and tobacco close it warm.

name: Viking Cologne
description: Lemon, pink pepper, bergamot and mandarin open lively. Lavender, geranium, nutmeg and sage add herbal spice, and sandalwood, patchouli, frankincense, cedarwood and vetiver give a woody base.

name: Cool Water
description: A cool rush of mint, lavender, rosemary and sea notes opens, with jasmine and geranium softening the heart. Sandalwood, musk and oakmoss give it a clean, mossy base.

name: Addict Eau Fraîche
description: Bright bergamot opens onto lily of the valley and freesia, then settles on soft musk. A clean, dewy floral that stays light and airy throughout.

name: Dior Homme Parfum
description: Iris sits at the centre, powdery and cool, wrapped in warm amber and patchouli with a dry vetiver edge. Earthy and softly smooth.

name: Fahrenheit Parfum
description: Mandarin brightens a smoky heart of leather and violet, all of it resting on sweet vanilla. Powdery and dark at the edges, with a quiet warmth underneath.

name: Fahrenheit
description: Lavender, mandarin and bergamot lift a floral heart of jasmine, honeysuckle and violet leaf, before leather, tonka bean and vetiver take over. Crisp, unusual and gradually warmer.

name: Homme
description: Earthy and woody from start to finish: cedarwood leads, patchouli adds a damp, dark depth, and vetiver dries everything down to a quiet root.

name: Homme Cologne
description: A cool splash of bergamot and grapefruit over clean musk. Light, crisp and simple, it reads like freshly laundered linen in morning sun.

name: Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum
description: Jasmine sambac sits in a warm, creamy cloud of tonka bean and vanilla. Sweet, enveloping and slightly narcotic, it unfolds slowly on skin.

name: J'adore Infinissime
description: A radiant bouquet of rose, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang and tuberose, brightened by bergamot and blood orange and settling onto creamy sandalwood. Rounded and soft.

name: Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming
description: Red berries give a juicy first impression before peony and rose open up. A clean musk keeps the whole bouquet light and fresh.

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
description: Peony and rose gather in a fresh, airy bouquet, lifted by bergamot and finished with clean, soft musk. Gentle, springlike and uncomplicated.

name: Miss Dior Parfum
description: Mandarin opens a rounded jasmine heart, then amberwood brings a creamy, glowing warmth. Floral and citrusy at first, softer and deeper as it dries.

name: Miss Dior Rose N'Roses
description: Rose leads in a sparkling, dewy way, with mandarin adding a citrus lift and soft musk trailing behind. A light, fresh floral.

name: Poison Girl
description: Bitter orange gives a zesty edge to a bright rose, with tonka bean adding a sweet, soft warmth underneath. Playful and fresh.

name: Pure Poison
description: Bergamot flickers over orange blossom, resting on soft, creamy musk. A white floral that feels clean, luminous and quietly sweet.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
description: Spicy and herbal at the heart: Sichuan pepper, anise, nutmeg and lavender, under a bright bergamot lift. Ambroxan and vanilla bring a smooth, warm finish.

name: Sauvage
description: Sharp, bright bergamot and pepper give way to amberwood with a warm, mineral glow. Crisp, spicy and easy to wear.

name: Sauvage Eau Forte
description: Cold spices and lavender sit over a smooth musk. Herbal and fresh, with a chilly bite that gradually softens against the skin.

name: Do Son
description: Rose, iris and orange blossom open soft, tuberose and pink pepper fill the heart, and benzoin with musk leave it creamy and warm.

name: Eau de Lierre
description: Galbanum opens green and sharp, cyclamen adds a cool floral note, and rosewood gives a light, woody finish. Like ivy on a damp wall.

name: Eau de Minthé
description: Nutmeg and mint start cool and spiced, geranium and rose add a floral heart, and patchouli rounds it with earthy depth.

name: L'Eau des Hesperides
description: Bitter orange and lemon open sharp, mint adds a cooling, herbal lift, and immortelle leaves a dry, golden finish. Fresh and a little bitter.

name: Philosykos
description: Fig runs through the whole scent: the leaf, the milky fruit and the woody branch, with coconut and green leaves adding sweetness. Cedarwood grounds it.

name: Vetyverio
description: A spiced floral heart of geranium, ylang-ylang, rose, nutmeg and clove, brightened by bergamot and mandarin. Vetiver, musk and cedarwood end dry and clean.

name: Light Blue
description: Apple and cedarwood open crisp, with bamboo, jasmine and rose in the heart. Amber and musk soften the finish, giving a breezy, green-floral scent with a lemony brightness.

name: Q by Dolce&Gabbana
description: Lemon and blood orange start sharp and juicy, with jasmine adding a floral touch. Cherry and heliotrope bring a powdery sweetness, settling on cedarwood and a clean bed of musk.

name: The One for Men Eau de Parfum
description: Basil, coriander and grapefruit open aromatic, then cardamom, ginger and orange blossom warm the heart. Cedarwood, tobacco and amber make the base smooth, dry and softly spicy.

name: Green Wood
description: Lemon, santolina and pepper open sharp and herbal, with cedarwood, vetiver and resins in the heart. Cypriol, ambroxan and musk add a smoky, earthy base with a resinous warmth.

name: Original Wood
description: Violet leaf, cardamom and an aquatic accord open cool and green, followed by fir balsam, vetiver and cedarwood. Patchouli, amber and musk give the base a soft, earthy depth.

name: Musk
description: Clean, bright and woody: bergamot, grapefruit and verbena over white rose and cedar, with sandalwood, vanilla and a musk finish.

name: Udaipur
description: Floral and creamy: bergamot, pink pepper and magnolia over jasmine sambac, gardenia and lotus, ending on patchouli, cashmere wood and musk.

name: Via Verri
description: Peppery citrus meets flowers: bergamot, pepper and jasmine, then iris, rose and cardamom, resting on cypress, amber and musk.

name: Fleur Narcotique Extrait
description: Bergamot, lychee and osmanthus open juicy and bright, then peony, orange blossom, jasmine and freesia fill the heart. Sandalwood, oakmoss and musk give it a smooth, creamy finish.

name: London Spice
description: Lemon, bergamot and mint open crisp, then lavender, jasmine and sea notes make a breezy heart. Patchouli, cedarwood, nutmeg and cardamom warm the base with a gentle spice.

name: Oud Noir Intense Parfum
description: Bergamot and cardamom open bright and spiced, with rose and jasmine in the heart. Sandalwood, saffron, patchouli, vanilla and amber make a rich, warm and slightly sweet base.

name: Oud Orange Intense
description: Coconut and sweet fruit open soft and creamy, then vanilla takes over the heart. Musk and oud close it, a warm, resinous scent with a smooth, sugary glow.

name: Eau de Magnolia
description: Bergamot lifts an earthy magnolia heart threaded with vetiver and patchouli. Cedarwood, oakmoss and amber give it a mossy, woody base.

name: Music for a While
description: A fruity, comforting blend: lemon, mandarin and bergamot with lavender, falling to patchouli and labdanum.

name: Northern Love

description: Deep and sweet: Bulgarian and Turkish rose with saffron, over oud, vanilla and cypriol, then caramel, benzoin and castoreum.

name: all of me
description: Magnolia opens soft and creamy, with rose and geranium in the heart. Sandalwood and musk close it quietly, a smooth floral that stays gentle and close to the skin.

name: all of me intense
description: Iris and jasmine sambac open powdery and bright, then rose, geranium and tuberose deepen the heart. Musk, vanilla and sandalwood leave a creamy, sweet and softly woody finish.

name: For Her Intense
description: Peach and bergamot open soft and juicy over white flowers and a clear heart of musk. Vanilla and vetiver ground it, giving a smooth, skin-like finish.

name: Musc Noir Rose for Her
description: Bergamot and pink pepper give a bright, peppery start, then musk and tuberose bloom together. Vanilla, patchouli and suede make the base warm, smooth and softly dark.

name: Blamage
description: White woods open pale and dry, with a leather heart that smells smoky and slightly tarry. Birch and musk close it, a dark, woody, skin-warm scent.

name: Nudiflorum
description: A soft floral veil lifts off a base of musk. Clean, quiet and close to the skin, it reads as warm skin more than flowers, with the musk repeating gently through to the end.

name: Pardon
description: Magnolia opens floral, then cinnamon, tonka bean and chocolate make a sweet, spiced heart. Sandalwood and oud ground it, giving the sweetness a smooth, dark, woody depth.

name: Nina
description: Lime and lemon give a tart, bright opening, with gardenia and apple adding a fruity floral heart. Musk and cedarwood leave the finish clean and lightly woody.

name: Fan Your Flames X
description: Rum, coconut and mastic open boozy and sweet, with tobacco and thyme in the heart. Patchouli, cedarwood and oakmoss add an earthy, herbal depth.

name: Hold Me Closer
description: Chamomile, hawthorn and wisteria lead softly, then frankincense and angelica add a resinous calm. Vanilla, opoponax and tonka bean make the base warm and sweet.

name: Tero
description: Caramel and two kinds of pepper start sweet and sharp together. Patchouli and cinnamon deepen the heart, while vetiver and amber give the base a dry, woody warmth.

name: A
description: Mango, coconut and pink pepper open bright and creamy, with jasmine, orchid and iris in a powdery heart. Musk, amber, patchouli, tonka bean and vanilla give a sweet, warm base.

name: Anniversario
description: Strawberry, blueberry, peach and saffron open sweet and fruity, then rose, jasmine and heliotrope soften the heart. Patchouli, oud, musk and vanilla give it a dark, warm base.

name: Annone
description: Bergamot, saffron and mango open bright and golden, followed by rose and iris in a powdery floral heart. Musk, amber, cypriol and oud give the base a resinous, smoky warmth.

name: Auris
description: Grapefruit, lime, yuzu and lychee open zesty and juicy, with ginger, mint, myrtle and juniper making a cool, herbal heart. Ambergris, tonka bean and cedarwood leave a smooth, woody base.

name: Così Blu
description: Cardamom, nutmeg and strawberry open spiced and fruity, then magnolia, rose and jasmine bloom softly. Incense, sandalwood, ambergris and musk leave a creamy, smoky finish.

name: Dolce Passione
description: Honey and chocolate open rich and dark, with plum, strawberry and vanilla in a sweet, fruity heart. Mushroom and tonka bean add an earthy, smooth base, giving the sweetness real depth.

name: Donna Margherita
description: Jasmine and tuberose open lush, with daffodil, frangipani and lily of the valley adding a creamy, green floral heart. Amber and musk soften the base into a warm, glowing finish.

name: Il Giardino
description: Ivy opens green and cool, with apple, pear and vetiver in a fresh, earthy heart. Leather, cedarwood, benzoin and musk give the base a dry, smooth, slightly resinous warmth.

name: M
description: Blackcurrant, plum, raspberry and strawberry open sweet and jammy, then lily of the valley, iris, rose and Turkish rose make a powdery floral heart. Labdanum, patchouli and ambergris finish it warm.

name: Pantheon R
description: Cinnamon, thyme, strawberry and rhubarb open tart and spiced, then iris, jasmine and saffron fill the heart. Balsam of Peru, incense, labdanum, oud and leather make a deep, resinous base.

name: Raffaello
description: Absinthe opens green and herbal, then tonka bean, pepper and pink pepper make the heart sweet and spiced. Leather, teak wood and patchouli close it dry and woody.

name: Althaïr Exclusif
description: Bergamot, amaretto and saffron open sweet and spiced. Cinnamon, orange blossom and cardamom bloom, then praline, vanilla and guaiac wood leave a rich, warm base.

name: Athalia
description: Incense, rose and bitter orange begin with a gentle spice. Iris and suede soften the heart, and amber, vanilla and vetiver bring a warm, powdery finish.

name: Athénaïs
description: Neroli, bergamot and yuzu lift an airy opening. Orange blossom and jasmine bloom softly, with tonka bean, vanilla and ambroxan leaving a creamy, sweet trail.

name: Carios
description: Saffron and pink pepper add spark to bergamot and mandarin. Geranium, thyme and pepper follow, while cedarwood, ambroxan, vetiver and tonka bean warm the base.

name: Cassili
description: Red currant and rose open with a juicy sweetness. Plum, mimosa and frangipani give a powdery floral heart, ending on sandalwood, tonka bean and vanilla.

name: Castley
description: A peppery, bright start of bergamot and ginger. Petitgrain, Sichuan pepper and neroli add a green, floral note, resting on akigalawood, labdanum and benzoin.

name: Delina Exclusif
description: Turkish rose and incense carry a resinous heart, brightened by bergamot, pear and lychee. Oud, amber and vanilla sweeten and deepen the base.

name: Delina La Rosée
description: Lychee, pear and bergamot open dewy and fruity. Turkish rose and peony bloom softly, and wood, musk and vetiver give a clean finish.

name: Eragon
description: Bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and mandarin open bright and spiced. Cinnamon, davana and cypriol give an earthy heart, and leather, tonka bean, vanilla and patchouli end warm.

name: Greenley
description: Icy and crisp, it opens on cashmere wood, lemon sorbet and bergamot. Cedarwood, apple and mandarin follow, with musk, rum and amber adding a faint sweetness.

name: Meliora
description: Raspberry and blackcurrant start juicy and tart, rose, lily of the valley and ylang-ylang bring a fresh floral heart, and vanilla with musk finish it gently.

name: Oriana
description: Mandarin, lemon and grapefruit open sparkling. Orange blossom, jasmine and chantilly cream turn sweet, and marshmallow, praline, ambroxan and musk give a soft, sugary end.

name: Palatine
description: Fresh mandarin and pear meet bergamot at the start. Violet and lavandin create a clean, herbal heart, and sandalwood, patchouli, musk and vanilla soften the finish.

name: Safanad
description: Orange and pear open juicy, then orange blossom, ylang-ylang and iris form a creamy, powdery heart. Amber, sandalwood and vanilla give it a warm base.

name: Valero
description: Bergamot, cedrat and juniper open sharp and green. Geranium, lavender, cypress and nutmeg follow, and patchouli, sandalwood and ambroxan finish dry and clean.

name: Changing Constance
description: Spicy-sweet and smoky: cardamom, salted caramel and tobacco.

name: Changing Constance Intense
description: A stronger, spicier take: saffron, pimento and salted caramel.

name: Empressa
description: Soft peach with bergamot, deepened by patchouli.

name: Fortuitous Finley
description: Green and leathery with a creamy twist: pistachio, violet leaf and leather.

name: Halfeti
description: A rich oriental built on saffron, cardamom, cinnamon and rose, opening with grapefruit and bergamot. Leather, oud, amber and vanilla give a deep, resinous, smoky base.

name: The Blazing Mr Sam
description: Cardamom opens bright, and cinnamon and pepper turn up the heat in the heart. Cedarwood, patchouli and tobacco form a dry, earthy, warm base.

name: The Coveted Duchess Rose Intense
description: A deeper, sweeter rose: vanilla, rose and amber.

name: The Favourite
description: Green, soft and powdery: violet leaf, mimosa and musk.

name: The Manoeuvres of the Baroness
description: Creamy and floral: orange blossom, chantilly and sandalwood.

name: The Tragedy of Lord George
description: Lavender and rum open aromatic and boozy, with tonka bean making the heart sweet and smooth. Ambroxan, vetiver and cedarwood dry the finish into something warm and woody.

name: Amber
description: Mimosa, bitter orange, mandarin and bergamot open sunny. Rose and patchouli bring an earthy floral heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood and benzoin leave a sweet, soft base.

name: Candy
description: Musk, benzoin and caramel: sweet, resinous and snug. A warm gourmand that stays soft and close.

name: Candy Gloss
description: Blackcurrant and cherry open juicy, orange blossom and peach add a fruity floral heart, and heliotrope, musk and benzoin leave a powdery, resinous finish.

name: La Femme Intense
description: Tuberose and ylang-ylang make a lush, creamy floral, deepened by earthy patchouli. Dense, flowery and dark at the edges.

name: Les Infusions Iris
description: Iris, mandarin and neroli open fresh and clean. Cedarwood, vetiver and galbanum add a green, woody structure, while incense and benzoin soften the base.

name: Les Infusions Mandarine
description: Bitter orange and a touch of mandarin start bright, orange blossom and neroli bring a floral heart, and opoponax adds a creamy, resinous finish.

name: Luna Rossa
description: Bitter orange and lavender open fresh and herbal. Clary sage and mint cool the heart, and ambrette and ambroxan leave a clean, amber-tinged base.

name: Luna Rossa Sport
description: Ginger and juniper open sharp and fresh. Tonka bean and vanilla add a sweet warmth, with lavender running through for an aromatic edge.

name: Olfactories Cargo de Nuit
description: Musk and aldehydes begin airy, woody notes and a mineral accord add a salty dryness, and coumarin with ambroxan leaves a powdery, warm trail.

name: Olfactories Nue Au Soleil
description: Orange blossom and neroli give a creamy, sunlit floral, resting on patchouli and musk. Soft, skin-warm and slightly earthy.

name: Olfactories Purple Rain
description: Iris, orange blossom and vetiver make a powdery, creamy floral with an earthy backbone. Quiet and soft, with a cool, dry edge.

name: Paradoxe Intense
description: Bergamot, neroli and pear open bright, jasmine and oakmoss add a green floral depth, and amber, vanilla and musk make the base creamy and warm.

name: Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry
description: Blackcurrant opens fruity and tart, orange blossom brings a creamy floral sweetness, and neroli keeps it light.

name: 1 Million Lucky
description: Grapefruit, sea notes and plum open fresh and juicy. Jasmine, cashmere wood, hazelnut and honey add sweet warmth, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss ground the end.

name: 1 Million Privé
description: Mandarin, cinnamon and apple open warm and bright. Tobacco and myrrh make a smoky, resinous heart, and patchouli with tonka bean leaves a sweet, earthy base.

name: Fame in Love
description: Mandarin, strawberry and basil open fruity and fresh. Incense, iris and jasmine create a powdery heart, and a mineral accord, vanilla and patchouli complete the base.

name: Fame Parfum
description: Incense opens with a faint smoke, musk brings a clean softness, and jasmine adds a gentle floral glow. Resinous, smooth and quiet.

name: Invictus Legend
description: Grapefruit and sea notes open salty and crisp, laurel leaf and geranium add an herbal heart, and guaiac wood with amber leaves a warm, smoky base.

description: Grapefruit opens sharp, lavender and oakmoss create an herbal, mossy heart, and mint and patchouli add a cool, earthy finish.

name: Invictus
description: Grapefruit, sea notes and mandarin start bright and salty. Bay and jasmine form the heart, and guaiac wood, oakmoss, patchouli and ambergris leave a mossy, earthy base.

name: Invictus Victory Elixir
description: Lavandin, cardamom and pepper open aromatic and spiced. Incense and patchouli bring an earthy, smoky heart, and vanilla and tonka bean end sweet and warm.

name: Lady Million Empire
description: Orange, neroli and red currant open juicy. Magnolia, orange blossom, osmanthus and plum create a lush floral heart, and cognac, patchouli and musk add a warm, boozy depth.

name: Lady Million Fabulous
description: Mandarin, pink pepper and sea notes open bright. Jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom creamily, and vanilla, oakmoss and tonka bean leave a sweet, mossy finish.

name: Lady Million Privé
description: Orange blossom opens soft over woody notes, heliotrope and raspberry sweeten the heart, and chocolate, honey and patchouli leave a rich, powdery base.

name: Phantom in Red
description: Plum, saffron and bergamot open fruity and spiced. Lavender, sage and orange blossom shape the heart, and amberwood, benzoin, tobacco and oud give a resinous, warm base.

name: Phantom Parfum
description: Vetiver and lavender run side by side, one earthy and one aromatic, with vanilla adding a sweet softness. Herbal, fresh and smooth.

name: Pure Xs for Her
description: Ylang-ylang and vanilla open sweet and floral, popcorn and ambrette add a toasty, musky heart, and vanilla returns with sandalwood for a warm, soft base.

name: Romance
description: Mandarin, pink pepper and violet leaf open bright and slightly peppery, then rose, jasmine and marigold bloom in the heart. Patchouli, oakmoss and musk lend an earthy, powdery finish.

name: Fiamma
description: Pear opens soft and juicy, and gardenia glows at the heart, touched with spice. Amber closes it warm, a floral that turns slowly from fruit to a golden, spiced base.

name: Feminite Du Bois
description: Cedarwood wrapped in spice and sweetness: honey, cinnamon, clove and cardamom, with plum, peach and violet in the heart. Sandalwood, benzoin, vanilla and musk keep it warm, dense and lingering.

name: La Fille de Berlin
description: Rose and geranium open bold and floral, with palmarosa giving a green, bright edge. Patchouli, honey and oakmoss darken the base, sweet and earthy in equal measure.

name: Il Padrino
description: Amaretto, blackcurrant, rum and bergamot open sweet and boozy, with amber, patchouli and sandalwood in the heart. Labdanum, vanilla and benzoin leave a rich, resinous glow.

name: Crying of Evil

name: God of Fire
description: Mango, lemon, pink pepper and ginger open bright and fruity, then coumarin, jasmine and dry wood warm the heart. Oud, cypriol, musk and amber give it a smoky, spiced base.

name: Lady White Snake
description: Mandarin, orange blossom and honeysuckle open sweet and bright, with magnolia, tuberose and jasmine in a creamy heart. Amber, leather and musk give the base a smoky, soft warmth.

name: Halley
description: Passion fruit, blackcurrant and rose open juicy and bright, with a long floral heart of iris, tuberose and peach. Vanilla, oud and cedarwood end warm.

name: Orza
description: Apple, plum and coconut lead into jasmine, rose and lily of the valley. Sandalwood, vanilla and caramel make the finish creamy, sweet and softly floral.

name: Porpora
description: Rose and raspberry begin with a hint of cinnamon, and incense gives the heart a smoky edge. Benzoin, myrrh and amber leave a resinous, warm base.

name: Bois Pacifique
description: Turmeric adds a dry, golden spice at the top, leaving sandalwood and oakwood to take over. Woody, warm and quiet.

name: Grey Vetiver
description: Grapefruit, orange blossom and sage open sharp, then nutmeg, iris and pimento add a powdery spice. Vetiver, amber and oakmoss ground it in earthy warmth.

name: Jasmin Rouge
description: Bergamot, mandarin and a quartet of spices open warm. Jasmine sambac and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, then vanilla, labdanum, leather and amber give a creamy, resinous finish.

name: Mandarino di Amalfi
description: A garden of citrus and herbs: tarragon, mint, basil, grapefruit and lemon over orange blossom and jasmine. Vetiver, amber and musk quietly hold the base.

name: Noir Extreme
description: Mandarin, saffron and cardamom open spiced and glowing. Orange blossom and jasmine soften the heart, while vanilla, sandalwood and amber give a rich, creamy base.

name: Oud Minérale
description: Sea notes meet oud in a salty, resinous blend, finished with ambergris. Mineral and rich, it smells like warm rock beside cool water.

name: Santal Blush
description: Sandalwood sits creamy and smooth, with cinnamon adding a gentle spice and ylang-ylang a soft floral lift. Warm, rounded and subtle.

name: Velvet Orchid
description: Bergamot, mandarin and honey open the door to a thick floral heart of jasmine, rose, orchid and magnolia. Suede, myrrh and sandalwood finish plush and resinous.

name: Behind the Curtain Piazza alla Scala
description: Warm, spiced woods: bergamot, saffron and clove over jasmine, labdanum and juniper, ending on cedar, sandalwood and patchouli.

name: District of Nolo
description: Fresh and fruity-floral: lemon, pear and violet leaf, iris and rose at the heart, and a base of musk and vanilla.

description: Warm and spicy with sweetness: anise, cardamom and lemon over pepper and patchouli, ending on vanilla and a liqueur accord.

name: Limitless Shopping Via della Spiga
description: A sweet floral with honey: bergamot, apple and honey over rose and jasmine, resting on heliotrope, tonka bean and musk.

name: Musc Noir Perfume Enhancer
description: A musky-floral blend: iris and lime open to jasmine, resting on cedarwood and musk.

name: My Name
description: Violet and heliotrope open powdery and sweet, with lilac, musk and lily in the heart. Amber and vanilla give the base a warm, enveloping softness.

name: Primo
description: Grapefruit and maple make a bright, slightly sweet opening, with geranium and pimento adding floral spice. Patchouli and wood ground the base, warm and earthy.

name: Ruby Red
description: Bergamot, red fruits and ginger open juicy and bright, then cinnamon, ylang-ylang and vanilla make the heart warm and sweet. Sandalwood and patchouli ground it, smooth and spiced.

name: The Italian Artists of Via Solferino
description: Mineral and tea-like at the start, with magnolia, ginger and peony in the centre, resting on heliotrope, patchouli and suede.

name: The Street Artists of Isola
description: Airy and musky: ambrette, water lily and cyclamen over fennel and iris, closing on musk and white woods.

name: Trussardi Black Extreme
description: Green and powdery with a dark base: lemon, galbanum and cypress over iris, plum and violet, then patchouli, vetiver and leather.

name: Trussardi Elegantly Cool
description: Soft and creamy: sesame, neroli and grapefruit lead to mimosa, ylang-ylang and jasmine, finishing on musk, tonka bean and sandalwood.

name: Trussardi Pure Jasmine
description: A creamy jasmine: bergamot, pistachio and neroli open to champaca and jasmine, resting on patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla.

name: Trussardi Uomo
description: A classic fresh masculine: lemon, bergamot and nutmeg, clary sage, geranium and violet over patchouli, musk and leather.

name: Walking in Porta Venezia
description: Aromatic and warm: anise, lemon and pepper over violet, absinthe and geranium, ending on patchouli, vanilla and cedar.

name: Walking on Via Fiori Oscuri
description: A powdery, sweet floral: mandarin and bergamot, mimosa, magnolia and rose, resting on rice powder, tonka bean and vanilla.

description: Violet leaf and vetiver open green, salt and sage add a mineral, herbal note, and wood and ginger leave a dry, spiced finish.

description: Rose and iris form the heart, lit by bergamot and saffron. Leather, patchouli and vanilla give a powdery, warm base.

name: Donna Born in Roma Coral Fantasy
description: Orange opens sunny, jasmine and rose bloom softly, and ambrette with musk leaves a clean, skin-close finish.

name: Donna Born in Roma Intense
description: Jasmine in a sweet cloud of vanilla, held warm by resinous benzoin. A soft floral with a creamy, amber-like finish.

name: Donna Born in Roma Yellow Dream
description: Juicy lychee, bergamot and lemon open bright. Peony and Turkish rose follow, and musk, vanilla and cedarwood keep it soft and clean.

name: Uomo Born in Roma Coral Fantasy
description: Apple and bergamot open juicy, sage and geranium add an herbal heart, and vanilla, tobacco and patchouli make a sweet, earthy base.

name: Uomo Born in Roma Yellow Dream
description: Pineapple, lime and mandarin open bright and sweet. Lavender, geranium and gingerbread add warm spice, and vanilla, amber and cedarwood end smooth.

name: Uomo
description: Bergamot opens clean, then coffee, hazelnut and chocolate create a sweet, roasted heart. Leather and cedarwood add a dry, woody base.

name: Valentina
description: Strawberry and bergamot open fruity. Jasmine and patchouli add a floral, earthy heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.

name: Dylan Blue Pour Homme
description: Aquatic accord, fig, bergamot and grapefruit open fresh. Violet leaf, patchouli, papyrus and pepper follow, and musk, tonka bean, saffron and frankincense add warm depth.

name: Eros Eau de Parfum
description: Lemon, mandarin, mint and apple open cool and green. Geranium and clary sage add a herbal heart, and cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla make a woody, sweet base.

name: Eros Eau de Toilette
description: Mint, lemon and apple open crisp. Tonka bean and geranium add sweetness, and vanilla, vetiver, cedarwood and oakmoss leave a warm, mossy finish.

name: Eros Najim
description: Mandarin, clary sage, saffron and cardamom open golden. Oud, cedarwood and caramel create a sweet, resinous heart, and patchouli, vetiver, incense and tonka bean end deep and warm.

name: Eros Parfum
description: Lemon, mandarin and pepper open fresh and bright. Geranium, clary sage and lavender shape the heart, and cashmeran, benzoin, vetiver, patchouli and vanilla add a sweet, woody base.

name: Man Eau Fraiche
description: Lemon, rose and carambola open bright and juicy. Tarragon, clary sage and cedarwood create an herbal, woody heart, and sycamore wood, amber and musk end clean.

name: Dreamer
description: Juniper, artemisia and tarragon open green and herbal. Iris and amber lily bring a powdery floral softness, and tobacco flower with amber leaves a warm finish.

name: Mango Skin
description: Blackberry, mango and pepper open juicy with a hint of spice, then iris, lotus and jasmine soften the heart. Patchouli, vanilla and sugar make the base warm and sweet.

name: Morning Chess
description: Bergamot opens bright, and leather and galbanum give the heart a green, smoky edge. Patchouli and amber close it earthy and warm, a fresh start that settles into dry leather.

name: Smoke Show

name: Black II
description: Plum and mandarin open fruity and bright, then rose, sandalwood and musk make a soft, floral heart. Vanilla and oakmoss give the base a creamy, mossy warmth.

name: London
description: Oud, violet and cypress open dark and green, with raspberry and lily of the valley adding a fruity, floral heart. Leather, vanilla, amber and musk close it warm and smooth.

name: New York
description: Mandarin, bergamot and juniper open crisp and sparkling, with lavender, pink pepper and coriander adding an aromatic, lightly spiced freshness. Clean and herbal throughout.

name: Black Opium Intense
description: Absinthe and liquorice open on a sweet, dark note, then jasmine sambac and orange blossom bloom. Vanilla, sandalwood and coffee build a rich, creamy base.

name: Black Opium Le Parfum
description: Coffee and vanilla form a warm, sweet base beneath a veil of floral notes. Dark, cosy and gourmand, with a soft flowery glow.

name: Black Opium Pink Glaze
description: Mandarin, strawberry and bergamot give a candied, bright start before jasmine and orange blossom. Amber, coffee, patchouli, vanilla and resins close it warm and sweet.

name: Kouros
description: A complex classic: aldehydes, absinthe and sage open sharp, carnation and iris add a powdery floral heart, and honey, leather, civet and amber leave an animalic warmth.

name: Libre Berry Crush
description: Juicy raspberry and creamy coconut meet orange blossom and lavender, resting on soft vanilla. Sweet and fruity, with a herbal thread running through.

name: Libre Eau de Toilette
description: Bergamot, mandarin and lavender give a fresh, clear start. Orange blossom, jasmine and tea follow, finishing on a soft blend of musk, vanilla and ambergris.

description: Lavender and orange blossom open into jasmine sambac and orchid, then tonka bean, vanilla and ambergris with a dry vetiver edge. Creamy, floral and warm.

description: Mandarin, ginger and saffron start bright and a little spicy. Bergamot, orange blossom and lavender follow, settling on honeyed vanilla and dry vetiver.

name: Libre Vanille Couture
description: Blackcurrant, lavender and mandarin lead into a heart of jasmine and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber, cedarwood and musk give it a creamy, polished finish.

name: Mon Paris Intensément
description: Juicy blackcurrant, raspberry and pear open the way to rose, peony and freesia. Musk, patchouli and benzoin keep it soft and slightly sweet.

name: Muse
description: Iris, vanilla and black ink: powdery, sweet and faintly smoky. It wraps the skin in warmth with a dark, papery edge.

name: Myslf Intense
description: Bergamot lifts a heart of orange blossom and wood, finished with a smooth musk. Clean, floral and woody, with a citrus freshness at the top.

name: Paris
description: A soft, powdery floral built on rose, violet and lily, with mimosa and green leaves up top. Sandalwood, iris, oakmoss and musk give it a gentle, creamy finish.

name: Y Eau de Parfum
description: Apple, juniper and sage sit under a sparkle of bergamot and ginger. Vetiver and frankincense hold the base, keeping the whole thing fresh, green and a little smoky.

name: Y Eau de Toilette
description: Geranium and lavender lead in a clean, herbal way, with incense giving a faint resinous glow. Fresh, floral and softly smoky.

name: Y Le Parfum
description: Ginger and bergamot give a sharp, bright start. Pine and fir balsam add a green, resinous chill before amber and patchouli warm the base.
